paragraphs: The Arbys Melt was a regular Arbys menu item many years ago and you many still find it there at a few of their restaurants but it is a well kept secret for the rest of the chain. The Arby Melt consists of 2 oz of Arbys famous roast beef with their melted cheddar cheese sauce on top and dripping down the sides of the sandwich. The Arby Melt is served on a sesame seed bun for extra taste. Beef and cheddar has always been a classic combination and melting is, in our opinion, the way to go when you're taking about cheese. So, if you didn't catch this item when it was on the Arbys menu, we suggest you order it from the Arbys secret menu .
Roast beef and melted cheddar cheese on a sesame seed bun.
Ask for an Arby's Melt, which adds melty cheddar cheese to your roast beef sandwich.
The Arby's Arby's Melt is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

This secret menu hack is one of the more simple hacks that we have, but simple doesn't mean it's not great. Adding bacon to your sandwich can drastically improve it if you're a bacon person, and who isn't? That's why we like the Bacon Beef 'n Cheddar Sandwich here at Hack The Menu. You can add bacon to pretty much any sandwich, but adding bacon to the Beef 'n Cheddar is our favorite combination. Be sure to check out the to see the menu prices and see what other sandwiches you want to add bacon to. Enjoy your bacony goodness, you can thank us later.
Add Bacon to the Beef 'n Cheddar Sandwich.
Ask to add Bacon to the Beef 'n Cheddar Sandwich.
The Arby's Bacon Beef 'n Cheddar is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Ordering the Double Stacked Reuben at Arby's means that you love your protein and want lots of it. An Arbys Double Stacked Reuben , which is served seasonally as long as Reubens are on the regular menu, means that they will serve you any Reuben that you order with twice the meat on the sandwich. So, instead of just 3.5 ounces of meat like they put on their regular sandwiches, they put 7 ounces of meat into the Double Stacked. An Arbys Double Stacked Reuben comes loaded with double the amount of corned beef that is used in their regular reubens. Or, to really mix things up, you can even order your Double Stacked at Arbys with half corned beef and half turkey!  Just one of the interesting items that you'll find only on the Arbys Secret Menu which doesn't appear on the Arbys regular menu .
A Reuben with twice the amount of meat, 7oz instead of 3.5oz.
Ask for a Reuben with double the meat of your choice. You can even get half turkey, half corned beef!
The Arby's Double Stacked Reuben is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Did you know that Arby's has many extra items that you can add to any sandwich for free at most locations (some items may cost extra at some locations)? Arbys carries many sauces, they have their regular sauce and their horsey sauce out there for everyone to grab. But, there's more behing the counter. That's right - there are secret sauces that you can add to your Arbys sandwich just for the asking. Add some Arbys Red ranch, a side of au-jus sauce, or any other sauce that Arby's carries for any regular menu item to add the flavor you're craving and make your sandwich your own. Any Arbys sauce, with the exception of Cheese sauce, can be added to any sandwich without an added charge, so add a sauce for free!  If you want cheese sauce, they will add that too but there will be an added charge. The secrets out. So, go ahead and sauce it up at Arbys.

Another secret that is unkown to the general public is that you can switch the bread used on any sandwich for any other bread that they carry at Arby's. They call this the Bread Switch . Switching it up not only creates new and fun combinations, but it's free of charge!  So, go ahead and order that Arbys Classic Roast Beef on an onion roll, or maybe try it on rye bread. That's right, any bread in the store is yours for the asking at Arby's. But only if you know the secret.

Have your ever heard of Arby's Onion Tanglers ?  These are tiny fried onion ring strips that are both tasty and crunchy. And guess what?  They can be added to any Arby's sandwich…for free!!  So, if there's a sandwich on the Arby's Secret Menu that you think would taste better with the crunchy onion tanglers then just ask politely for them to be added to your sandwich. If you're an onion lover, how awesome is that?  We think it's pretty awesome, so awesome in fact that it should be announced to rest of the world.
Add onion tanglers, any Arby's sauce, or swap out any bread for free on your sandwich.
Ask politely to switch out for your favorite bread or add any Arby's sauce or onion tanglers to your sandwich.
The Arby's Free Extras are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arby's French Dip & Swiss Max is their regular french dip sandwich with twice the meat. The French Dip Max consists of 7 oz of roast beef on a sub-roll with two slices of swiss cheese. That's twice the meat for twice the fun! This sandwich should be ordered by the really hungry. The French Dip Max is also served, of course, with their french dip sauce. You will find the french dip sandwich on the regular menu but the French Dip Max only exists on the Arby's Secret Menu . You can order extra meat for most of their sandwiches, as long as they let you. Got meat?
It's the French Dip & Swiss Sandwich with twice the meat.
Ask for a French Dip Max or ask them to double the meat on the regular French Dip.
The Arby's French Dip Max is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Jr. Deluxe on the Arby's Secret Menu gives a lighter, fresher taste to the classic Arby's Roast Beef sandwich. This Jr. Deluxe is filled with fresh slices of oven roasted roast beef, crisp lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and mayo on a sesame seed bun. Even though this is a Jr. sized sandwich, you can add lettuce and tomato to most any of the sandwiches at Arbys. The Jr. Deluxe from the Arby's Secret Menu is a great value and an even greater taste.
Roast Beef, lettuce, tomato, and mayo on a sesame seed bun.
Ask to add lettuce and tomato to a Jr. Roast Beef Sandwich.
The Arby's Jr. Deluxe is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Have you heard about the Meat Mountain Sandwich from the Arby's Secret Menu ? If you haven't, you better prepare yourself for something that might sound a little insane if you're not used to stuffing yourself as a competitive eater. If you think you're ready for a challenge, get ready to hear what's inside of this monster called the meat mountain sandwich. Chicken Tenders form the solid base of this mountain which is then topped with Roast Turkey, Ham, and then Swiss Cheese. But it doesn't end there, the rest of the sandwich is composed of Brisket, Corned Beef, Angus Steak, Cheddar Cheese, and finished off with their deliciously crispy Bacon. I'm not sure if you can find another secret menu item from any of our other Secret Menus that has this many different types of meat all in one sandwich. If you're brave enough to try this sandwich, don't forget to share a photo and post the #HackTheMenu hashtag.
A massive feast piled high with Chicken Tenders, Ham, Roast Turkey, Swiss Cheese, Corned Beef, Angus Steak, Brisket, Cheddar Cheese, Roast Beef, and topped with Bacon.
Ask politely if they serve the Meat Mountain . If they don't know what it is yet, you can ask for a sandwich filled with every type of meat they serve with some cheddar and swiss cheese thrown in.
The Arby's Meat Mountain is available at a limited set of locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

At Arby's, the basic roast beef sandwich is still king of the regular, which makes it hard to beat. But, imagine Arby's famous roast beef sandwich along with the creamy tang of classic swiss cheese melted atop your pile of roast beef. Then add a bun that has a touch of honey and the spice from a dab of brown mustard…this sandwich will hit every taste bud center in your entire mouth!  Can you picture it?  Well, you won't find a picture on the Arbys regular menu, but you can get it if you know about the Roast Beef & Swiss on the Arbys secret menu . Here's the technical description of the Arby's Roast Beef & Swiss sandwich - it's 3.5 oz of roast beef served on honey wheat bread with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, big-eye swiss cheese, mayonnaise, and spicy brown mustard!  Quite a taste sensation!
Oven-roasted roast beef, tomatoes, Swiss cheese, lettuce, onions, spicy brown honey mustard and mayo on honey wheat bread.
Ask for a Roast Beef & Swiss Sandwich, or add Swiss cheese to any sandwich.
The Arby's Roast Beef & Swiss Sandwich is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arby's Ham & Swiss Sandwich is a traditional pairing that has always tasted great together and gathered a loyal following. Sometimes you feel like a beef, sometimes you don't. So if that's the case you can get a Ham & Swiss at Arby's roast beef restaurants. Arby's Ham & Swiss consists of ham on honey wheat bread with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, big-eye swiss cheese, mayonnaise, and spicy brown mustard. We suggest you ask them to hold the mayo to make a healthier fast food menu option choice. You won't find this item on the  Arbys regular menu, so for a classic (yet secret) combination you must remember the name - Arbys Ham & Swiss .
Oven-roasted ham, tomatoes, Swiss cheese, lettuce, onions, spicy brown honey mustard and mayo on honey wheat bread.
Ask for a Roast Ham & Swiss Sandwich, or add Swiss cheese to any sandwich.
The Arby's Roast Ham & Swiss Sandwich is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arby's Super Roast Beef is their original roast beef sandwich, just dressed up a little. The super roast beef is 3 oz of roast beef like Arbys classic roast beef sandwich but they add their special red ranch sauce, lettuce and tomato and then place it all on a sesame seed bun. Order the Super Roast Beef if your taste buds demand somthing more unique than just beef on a bun like the classic roast beef sandwich from the Arbys regular menu. It pays to know secrets from all the fast food chain secret menus .
Roast beef, lettuce, tomato and red ranch sauce on a sesame seed bun.
Ask for a Super Roast Beef Sandwich and show them the ingredients if they don't know the recipe to this great secret menu item.
The Arby's Super Roast Beef Sandwich is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arbys Turkey Classic is much like their original classic roast beef sandwich, except they switch out the roast beef and use their freshly sliced turkey instead. They have plenty of turkey options on their regular menu, as they slice the turkey at their restaurants along with their Arbys famous roast beef, but this turkey classic was removed from their menu. But, don't let that stop you from ordering one. Arbys will still serve the turkey classic if you ask. If you'd like a sandwich with 3 oz of hot turkey on a sesame seed bun then just order the Arbys Turkey Classic from the Arbys secret menu .
Hot turkey on a sesame seed bun.
Ask for a Turkey Classic Sandwich or swap out the roast beef for turkey in Arby's classic roast beef sandwich.
The Arby's Turkey Classic Sandwich is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arbys Turkey & Cheddar Sandwich consists of their Turkey Classic sandwich plus the tasty addition of Arbys red ranch sauce and melted cheddar cheese sauce. Another difference is that the Turkey & Cheddar is served on an onion roll instead of their classic sesame seed roll. This sandwich is the ultimate among turkey sandwiches, and don't forget that Arbys slices their turkey right in their restaurants. Also keep in mind that with any sandwich on Arbys regular menu, you can pull a switcheroo with the bread type if you so choose. Or, you can even add some a free sauce, au jus, or even the crispy onion tanglers to your sandwich. That is, as long as you know the secrets.
Hot turkey on an onion roll with red ranch and melted cheddar cheese. (Can add bacon for an additional cost)
Ask to substitute for Turkey instead of roast beef on the Beef 'n Cheddar Classic.
The Arby's Turkey 'n Cheddar is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Arby's Turkey Reuben Sandwich is the seasonal favorite regular Reuben from Arbys regular menu, but made with turkey instead of their corned beef. The Arbys Turkey Reuben comes with 3.5 oz of hot turkey, sauerkraut, and thousand island dressing and is served on toasted rye bread. So, whether you're cutting down on red meat or just prefer the taste of turkey, an order of the Arbys Turkey Reuben from Arbys secret menu could be just the sandwich you've been searching for.
Hot turkey, saurkraut and thousand island dressing on toasted rye bread.
Ask for a Reuben with Turkey instead of corned beef.
The Arby's Turkey Reuben is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

At Arbys, the Ultimate BLT Sandwich is indeed ultimate. This sandwich, which is served on their special honey wheat bread includes 5 strips of bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise. The Ultimate BLT isn't offered at most fast food restaurants and isn't on the Arbys regular menu …it can only be found on Arbys secret menu . If you like bacon, Arbys Ultimate BLT just may be the sandwich for you.
Crispy strips of bacon on honey wheat topped with extra lettuce, tomato and mayo.
Ask for an Ultimate BLT Sandwich or show them this secret recipe.
The Arby's Ultimate BLT is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Imagine the forbidden love child of fast food giants – a secret menu hack so daring, it’s practically rebellious. Picture the legendary McDonald's Big Mac, but instead of its usual ensemble, it’s made entirely from Burger King 's Whopper ingredients. Intrigued? You should be.

This culinary crossover begins with the Whopper’s flame-grilled beef patties, bringing that smoky, backyard barbecue vibe straight to your taste buds. As you bite into it, the char-grilled goodness plays nicely with the additional middle bun (the club) and a melty slice of cheese.

Now, let’s talk layers. Instead of the Big Mac's signature middle bun, we have Burger King's sesame seed bun – sturdy and soft, providing the perfect foundation for this burger mash-up. On top of that, fresh, crispy lettuce and slices of juicy tomato from the Whopper, adding a burst of necessary freshness.

And oh, the pickles. Crisp, tangy, and slightly sweet, they mingle with finely chopped onions, creating a symphony of flavors that’ll make your taste buds sing. Want to spice up this secret menu hack a little more? Order a Double Bacon Whopper to get the smoky BK bacon. Yes, you heard right – bacon.

Cheese, you ask? Of course! Gooey, melty American cheese, oozing over the beef patties, binding everything together in a melty embrace. The result? A harmonious blend of McDonald's iconic Big Mac ingenuity with Burger King's bold, flame-grilled essence.
Big Mac's blueprint, grilled up using BK's own ingredients and flavors
Order a Double Whopper with cheese and add an extra Bun on the side. It's easiest if you assemble it yourself and chow down!
The Burger King Big Whopp is available at most all locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Burger King BLT burger is one of Burger King's most famous "secret menu" items for those looking for a twist on a classic meal. The BK BLT Burger is simply a Whopper or Whopper Junior topped with delicious bacon. How delicious does that sound? So, if you are tired of the basic Whopper, try a BK BLT burger from the secret menu. In our opinion, the BK BLT burger is a nice little meal that gives a lively twist on the classic bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich. When ordering, don't forget to grab a drink with your BK BLT to wash it down!
Classic BLT Toppings added to a Whopper or Whopper Jr.
Ask for extra Bacon to be added to your Whopper or Whopper Jr.
The Burger King BK BLT is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Burger King "BK Club" from the BK secret menu when a Chicken Sandwich is too plain for your tastes. Hidden on the Burger King secret menu is this BK Club sandwich that is made to imitate a chicken club sandwich. As you can probably imagine, this BK secret menu item is the deliciously crispy chicken sandwich topped with mouth-watering bacon, tomato, and cheese. Can't wait to try it yet? Hitch a ride over to your closest Burger King and grab the BK Club off their secret menu. Treat yourself to a BK Club and just sit back and enjoy this delicious masterpiece. The Burger King Secret Menu may not be as well known as others, but it sure has some delicious creations!
Extra Bacon, Tomato, & Cheese on a Chicken Sandwich

The Burger King BK Club is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Burger King Ham and Cheese is a classic Ham & Cheese sandwich on Burger King's signature bun. Is your mouth watering yet? If so, no need to worry. Go out and get yourself a Burger King Ham and Cheese right now! In our opinion, the Burger King Ham and Cheese is a refreshing sandwich in a land ruled by the King of the Burger. When ordering, don't forget to grab a drink to wash it down!
Ham & Cheese on a Sesame Seed Bun
Simply ask for Ham & Cheese on a Bun of your choice (ex. Sesame) from the Burger King Secret Menu!
The Burger King BK Ham and Cheese is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Burger King Breakfast Melt , a new addition to the BK breakfast secret menu, has become quite popular among fast-food fans. As someone who enjoys a good breakfast sandwich, I couldn’t resist the temptation to try it out. Little did I know that this unassuming little sandwich would become my new favorite breakfast item at Burger King.

Upon opening the wrapper, I was greeted by a warm, inviting sandwich that looked compact but satisfying. The Breakfast Melt consists of a toasted Melt bun filled with your choice of meat (bacon, sausage, or ham), a slice of American cheese, and a nice scrambled egg. I opted for the ham version because that's what I grew up with at home.

My first bite was a pleasant surprise. The sandwich is simple but effective. The toasted bun had a slight crunch, which contrasted nicely with the soft egg and gooey cheese. The ham added a salty, savory note that balanced the richness of the egg and cheese.

One of the standout features of the Breakfast Melt was the texture. The toasted Melt bread seemed to stand up better than the croissan'wiches tend to. It was less messy, which I quite enjoyed. Overall, the Breakfast Melt provided a satisfying, well-balanced meal.
The Breakfast Melt upgrades the classic BK breakfast sandwich by swapping out a bun or croissant for the Melt toast buns that is used on their new Melt burgers and sandwiches.

Ordering the Breakfast Melt is as easy as it gets at Burger King. Simply walk up to the counter or pull up to the drive-thru and ask for your breakfast sandwich of choice for the Burger King breakfast menu - and then ask them to substitute the croissant for the Melt buns.
Because the sandwich is part of Burger King’s standard breakfast menu , it shouldn't be too difficult to clarify what you want. You simply want to swap out the croissant for the Melt buns!

The cost of the BK Breakfast Melt can vary by location . Some restaurants may allow you to swap for the toast for free while others charge a minimal amount to make the switch. In general, it is not a significant upgrade, but you should always ask how much the price will increase before confirming your order.
The Burger King Breakfast Melt is available at most all locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Burger King Secret Menu has a lot of interesting burgers and sandwiches, but who knew that they had the genius to come up with Frings ! What are Frings , you ask?  Well, the crispy BK Frings are a treat that is the best of both worlds when it comes to side orders. The Burger King Fring masterpiece is a half order of French Fries and a half order of their Onion Rings. Can't decide?…you're not alone, it's a tough decision deciding between these two options. Luckily, at Burger King (if you know the secret) you aren't forced to make such a decision. Why order both when you can slim down and get the best of both worlds at the same time with Burger King Frings? When you get your favorite burger, don't forget to grab yourself a side order of Frings. This is the cherry on top of the Burger King Secret Menu.
Half French Fries, Half Onion Rings
Simply ask for an order of half french fries, half onion rings - or "Frings" - from the Burger King Secret Menu!
The Burger King Frings are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

So why not give this Mustard Whopper from the Burger King secret menu the chance that it deserves, and go get yourself one today!
Mustard on your Whopper instead of Mayo
Simply ask for Mustard on your Whopper instead of Mayo. Or you can get both!
The Burger King Mustard Whopper is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The simple cheeseburger that has been upgraded and topped with crunchy onion rings and tangy BBQ sauce to create this mouth-watering Rodeo Burger. Some people find the onion rings on the Rodeo Burger to be too much, but not us. Treat yourself to a Rodeo Burger off the BK secret menu. Extra Onion Rings & BBQ Sauce on your Cheeseburger
Ask for a couple Onion Rings & BBQ Sauce to be added onto your cheeseburger!
The Burger King Rodeo Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

What would the BK Secret Menu be if it didn't have a giant burger loaded with beef and cheese? That's where the Suicide Burger comes in. So if you like to live dangerously, this is your chance to experience some have only dreamed of trying. The Suicide Burger is also known as the " Quad Stacker " at some Burger King restaurants. The Suicide Burger may have two names, but it's the FOUR patties that make this Quad Stacker a stand-out on the Burger King secret menu. So why not give the Suicide Burger from the secret menu the chance that it deserves, but you may want to bring a friend for back-up!
4 Beef Patties, 4 Slices of Cheese, Bacon, & Special Sauce

Most Burger King locations sell the Triple Stacker, they may know this as a "Quad Stacker" if you're lucky. If they don't know what that is, then order a burger with 4 Patties, 4 slices of Cheese, and Bacon with their special sauce.
The Burger King Suicide Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

A Veggie Patty instead of Beef
Simply ask for a "Veggie Whopper" from the Burger King Secret Menu! This secret should be known by all staff.

I remember the day I first ventured into uncharted burger territory by adding an egg to my Carl's Jr. burger . It was a sunny afternoon, and my hunger was as fierce as my curiosity. I had heard whispers about this magical combination but had never dared to try it myself. That day, I decided to take the plunge and discover what all the hype was about.

As I placed my order, my anticipation grew. Would this addition transform my burger experience, or was it just another food fad? When my burger finally arrived, the aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water. There it was, nestled between the toasted buns: a perfectly cooked scrambled egg.

The first bite was nothing short of a revelation. The fluffy yellow egg sits atop the burger patty, blending seamlessly with the melted cheese. The egg added a rich, velvety layer of flavor that elevated the entire burger to new heights. Each bite was a harmonious symphony of textures and tastes – the burger patty delivered its signature richness while the egg added a buttery smoothness that tied everything together.
What made it so delicious was the unexpected yet perfect pairing of flavors. The subtle seasoning of the egg added a new dimension to the familiar burger, making it feel both comforting and exciting.

Adding an egg to a Carl's Jr. burger isn't just about trying something new; it's about discovering a culinary combination that feels both innovative and timeless . It's a reminder that sometimes the simplest additions can create the most profound changes. So next time you're at Carl's Jr., take a leap of faith and add an egg to your burger. Trust me, your taste buds will thank you.
Adding a scrambled egg to any burger at Carl's Jr brings a whole new level to their burger game. The fluffy egg adds a luxurious richness and flavor that complements the savory burger.

During the hours when Carl's Jr. is serving their breakfast menu, you will need to ask if it's possible to add an egg to burger of your choice. Heck, you could even double up and get two eggs on your burger!
The Carl's Jr. Add an Egg is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Chicken Stuffed Star is the even more ultimate version of the McGangBang. The burgers are bigger, but so is the price tag. It will fill you up, just like the McGangBang, but it might empty your wallet with the $6+ price tag.
This Carl's Jr. Secret Menu hack isn't healthy like most the others, but it should grab your attention better. We like the extremes here on #HackTheMenu, and this burger definitely is extreme.
A Spicy Chicken sandwiched between the burger patties of a Super Star - compare to the McDonald's McGangBang
The easiest way is to order both and put the Spicy Chicken Sandwich between the burger patties. However, if you ask nicely and explain it, they might be obliged to assemble it for you.
The Carl's Jr. Chicken Stuffed Star is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The Carl's Jr. Secret Menu is fairly new, and the secret menu options will continue to grow. But the Low Carb It.® option at Carl's Jr. is one of the coolest option around. Similar to In-N-Out's Protein Style Burger , the Low Carb It.® hack makes any burger healthier and lighter . That's not to say that it tastes worse, in fact, a bunch of us actually prefer our burgers and sandwiches that way based solely on taste!

How many calories and carbs does the Trim It.® option save you? Up to 300 calories and 48g of carbs can be trimmed off your meal by simply swapping out those lame buns for some crisp lettuce! That's a lot of calories that you just saved yourself, and they were mainly just empty carbs. If you like to maintain a healthy lifestyle, but have to grab a quick bite from a fast food joint every now and then, you should check out our list of healthy secret menu items .
Turn any regular burger into a lettuce wrapped burger.
Simply order your burger and ask to " Low Carb It ." Or if you can't remember its name, just ask for it to be lettuce wrapped.
The Carl's Jr. Low Carb It.® is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Did you know that you can swap your combo at Carl's Jr. for a healthier alternative ? That's right, now at any Carl's Jr. you can swap out your fries and soda for something much healthier. Get salad and bottled water instead of greasy fries and a sugar-filled beverage.

Whether you're on a diet or just prefer to eat a salad instead of fries, this might be an option to consider. Of course, you can always just order a side salad and get a water cup to fill up at the soda fountain. Overall it is cheaper than this combo, but maybe you prefer to upgrade to bottled water. Either way, it's still an interesting option and it's your hard-earned money. So, buy whatever you want. But you may be interested in something else on our list of healthy secret menu items .
Swap out your fries and soft drink for a healthier alternative: salad and bottled water.
Ask the cashier to "swap your combo" out for a salad and bottled water.
The Carl's Jr. Swap Your Combo® is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Next time you go to Carl's Jr. and want to save a few calories on your order, you should consider either the Trim It. ® option or the Low Carb It.® option. Both these options will drop the total calorie count for your meal, but in completely different ways. The trim it option gets rid of up to 300 calories (carbohydrates) from the hamburger buns, while the Trim It option cuts out a lot of calories from fat, and just a few from protein. Another bonus is that you get a wheat bun, which is supposed to be healthier.

If you don't want to go all the way to the extent that trimming your burger would get you, there is another thing that you can try. It's not exactly the same, since Trim It gives you a chicken patty. However, there still is the chance that you can substitute your hamburger patty for a Turkey patty.

Hopefully not too many, this isn't the most heart-friendly meal out there. This is a delicious and refreshing take on the "build your own burger" experience at 5 Guys. Are you a big fan of the grilled bun texture of a grilled cheese sandwich, but have a craving for meat?  If so, you should definitely try out the Patty Melt from the Five Guys Secret Menu! You won't regret it. And check out the Double Grilled Cheese Burger that reportedly exits…if you want something even cheesier!
A Burger with buns grilled up like a Grilled Cheese Sandwich!

Ask for a Grilled Cheese Sandwich and then ask them to add Hamburger Patties and all of your favorite toppings inside the Grilled Cheese Sandwich. Make sure they know to grill up the Buns like they would for a Grilled Cheese!
The Five Guys Patty Melt is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The " Well Done Fries " are reportedly one of the best items on the Five Guys Secret Menu. Since you can put almost anything in any combination on your burger when ordering from the Five Guys main menu, there isn't much need to keep secrets as far as the burgers are concerned - just order it the way you like it. But when it comes to french fries, they have two kinds on the menu - five guys style or cajun style. Well, what if you like your fries well done? If you happen to be at a Five Guys Burger and Fries restaurant that will crisp up your fries to well done, then you're in luck! The extra crispy Five Guys Well Done Fries may be more to your liking, so it might be worth a shot to ask!
Fried longer for that extra crispy taste
Simply ask for "Well Done Fries".
The Five Guys Well Done Fries are available at a limited set of locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Heard of the In-N-Out 3 x 3 Burger? Is In-N-Out Burger's Double Double not filling you up?  Well, you are in luck. Hidden on In-N-Out Burger's "secret menu" is a burger called the 3 x 3. As you probably imagined, the secret menu's 3 x 3 made up of three 100% pure beef patties, hand-leafed lettuce, tomato, spread, three slices of American cheese, with or without onions, stacked high on a freshly baked bun. Mouth watering yet?  Some people find the third patty to be overwhelming, but not us. Treat yourself to a 3 x 3 …and a nice nap right after. In-N-Out Burger has one of the best secret menus out there, and the 3 x 3 is a prime example why. You are free to get any amount of burgers or slices of cheese that you want. Another staple on the In-N-Out secret menu is the 4 x 4 Burger .
Three All Beef Patties & Three Slices of Cheese
Simply ask for a 3x3 (3 by 3) Burger made with all your favorite toppings.
The In-N-Out 3 x 3 Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Is the In-N-Out Burger's Double Double not filling you up?  Tried the 3 x 3 Burger and it wasn't enough either?  Well, you are in luck. Hidden on In-N-Out Burger's "secret menu" is a burger called the 4 x 4. That's right an In-N-Out 4x4 includes 4 burgers & 4 slices of cheese! Like you probably guessed this is how it all stacks up - the secret menu's 4 x 4 made up of four 100% pure beef patties, hand-leafed lettuce, tomato, spread, three slices of American cheese, with or without onions, stacked high on a freshly baked bun. As you can see by the picture, the In-N-Out 4x4 is a whole lot meat. We suggest this secret menu item only for the biggest eaters as most people won't be able to finish this burger, let alone open their mouth wide enough to take a bite. but, we won't blame you for trying though!  Thanks In-N-Out.
4 All Beef Patties & 4 Slices of Cheese
Simply ask for a 4x4 (4 by 4) Burger made with all your favorite toppings.
The In-N-Out 4 x 4 Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

We would be willing to bet that most of the average In-N-Out goers don't know about the deliciously spicy yellow peppers that In-N-Out offers. They are just another one of the free toppings that In-N-Out so graciously offers its patrons. At some locations, they offer them up in little packets that can be grabbed near the ketchup station; however, most locations keep the packets in a fridge behind the counter.

What others don't know is that you can order chopped chilis directly on your burger . This is beneficial in two ways. First, you don't have to unwrap your perfectly packed burger and second, you aren't chomping down onto an entire chili "bomb" that's gonna explode when you chew it. The yellow chili peppers aren't that spicy, although some can be. They do add another layer of flavor to the burger and enhance it with their vinegar hit and spicy afterburn. It's something that should be mandatory for all spice lovers, and an option that should be explored by those who aren't. Try it out on the famous Animal Style Burger !
Spice up your burger with slices of their hot little yellow chilis/chilies!
When giving your order, just include "chopped chilis" to your list of toppings. Simple as that.
The In-N-Out Add Chopped Chilis are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Do you like tomatoes? How about lots of tomatoes? Like to walk the line between the perfect amount of tomatoes and too many stinkin' tomatoes? We've got you covered if that's your thing. Adding extra tomatoes is part of the In-N-Out Secret Menu . The best part of the secret menu, in fact. It's the FREE section.
Back to the important stuff, if you are ordering a Double Double or free extras from In-N-Out , you might learn something new today.
Make your burger extra thick and juicy with another slice or two of tomato!
Ask for "extra tomatoes" on your burger when they take your order.
The In-N-Out Add Extra Tomatoes are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Animal Style burger is one of In-N-Out Burger's most popular "secret menu" items. And for good reason!  This one might actually be the grand-pappy of all secret menu items. It's been around since the beginning and has developed quite a loyal following. In addition to the standard toppings, Animal Style burgers include pickles, extra spread, grilled onions and mustard fried onto each meat patty. How tasty does that sound?  So, if you are comfortable with eating a burger that can get a little sloppy, take a chance by asking for it Animal Style. In our opinion, the grilled onions and extra spread really seal the deal. When ordering, don't forget that you can get Animal Style Fries too!
Pickles, extra spread, grilled onions, and mustard fried Burger Patties
Simply order your burger size (Cheeseburger, 2x2, 3x3…) and then ask for it to be made "Animal Style".
The In-N-Out Animal Style Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Animal Style Fries are one of the most popular items on In-N-Out Burger's "secret menu."  And if you've ever had them, you know why. Layered on top of hot french fries, ordering "Animal Style Fries" adds cheese, In-N-Out's secret spread, and grilled onions right on top. Pure goodness. While some people may find the Animal Style fries to be a little heavy, we think they are the perfect compliment to an In-N-Out burger. And don't forget that you can order an Animal Style Burger as well!
Melted Cheese, Secret Spread, & Grilled Onions piled high on your Fries
Simply walk up to the counter and ask for "Animal Style Fries".
The In-N-Out Animal Style Fries are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Cheese Fries are one of In-N-Out Burger's most popular secret menu items. You know why?  Because french fries are awesome, and cheese is awesome. Put them together and you've got In-N-Out Cheese Fries - which are double awesome! If you order Cheese Fries , be prepared for some gooey goodness that just might distract you from your burger. Is that even possible? So, if you don't mind a few extra calories, we suggest you go for some Cheese Fries to compliment your other secret menu selections at In-N-Out Burger. You'll be glad that you did. In our opinion, cheese fries can make a meal. If you are feeling extra bold and really adventuresome, don't forget that you can order Animal Style Fries instead (also from the In-N-Out secret menu)!
Melted Cheese layed over a delicious basket of Fries
Just ask for "Cheese Fries" and you shall receive the magical cheesy fries!
The In-N-Out Cheese Fries are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Double Meat Burger can be ordered off of In-N-Out Burger's "secret menu."  Not to be confused with the Double Double which is double meat & double cheese, the Double Meat Burger is made up of two 100% pure beef patties, hand-leafed lettuce, tomato, spread, with or without onions, stacked high on a freshly baked bun. That's double meat - it's perfectly designed for those who want a little extra protein in their meal without the extra cheese. By requesting this item, the team over at In-N-Out Burger will know that you mean business.
Add an additional All Beef Patty without getting extra cheese. You can stack as many as you like
Ask for a "Double Meat" Burger. If you want one slice of cheese, get a 2x1. If you get 2 slices, then you're just ordering the Double Double.
The In-N-Out Double Meat Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Extra Toast option is a simple item that can be found on the In-N-Out Burger secret menu . Simply put, by ordering Extra Toast your hamburger buns will be left on the grill for just a minute longer. The result is a bun with an extra crisp bite, something that can completely change your entire burger experience without adding anything to the price. Be careful though, sometimes you might be left with a bun that is just a little too brittle because the chefs don't get this request too often. So if you like the crusts of bread and prefer your toast dark, you gotta ask for and recieve the Extra Toast quickly!
An extra toasted hamburger bun
Ask for your burger buns to be "extra toasted" when they take your order.
The In-N-Out Extra Toast is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!
Did you know that this isn't the original In-N-Out Flying Dutchman?
Is the Tomato Wrapped Flying Dutchman Burger too wild for you? Check out the OG In-N-Out Flying Dutchman .
Or do you crave onions ? Try the Whole Grilled Onion Wrap Flying Dutchman Burger .

Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, gather 'round for a tale of culinary wizardry that'll make your taste buds do a triple backflip! Behold, the Tomato-Wrapped Flying Dutchman – the clandestine creation that's flipping the script on traditional burger norms faster than you can say " animal style "!

Picture this: two juicy beef patties, perfectly seasoned, mustard-grilled and smothered in gooey melted cheese. Now, hold onto your hats because we're about to take things up a notch. Instead of a boring old bun, these patties are wrapped in slices of ripe, juicy tomato – creating a flavor explosion that'll make you question everything you thought you knew about burgers.

But wait, there's more! This secret menu hack isn't just about taste – it's about pushing the boundaries of burger innovation. It's about taking risks, thinking outside the bun , and daring to defy convention. Ordering off-menu isn't just a meal – it's an experience. It's like being part of a delicious secret society, where only the boldest and most adventurous burger lovers dare to tread.

Now, let's talk about flavor , shall we? The Tomato-Wrapped Flying Dutchman isn't your average burger – it's what can only be described as tomato-ey. The sweetness of the tomato balances perfectly with the savory richness of the beef and cheese. So, if you wake up in the morning and the first thing you think is, " wow, I wish my mouth tasted like fresh-cut tomatoes right now ", then this burger is for you . There might be something wrong with your tastebuds, but at least there's a solution to your problem.

And hey, if you're feeling extra wild, why not add some grilled onions? Or maybe a splash of hot sauce for an extra kick? The possibilities are as endless as your imagination, my friends. So, grab your crew, buckle up, and get ready for a flavor adventure that'll have you craving more. Another popular similar to this one is the Whole Grilled Onion-Wrapped Flying Dutchman .
In conclusion, the Tomato-Wrapped Flying Dutchman secret menu hack at In N Out Burger is a game-changer. It's bold, it's daring, and it's guaranteed to not leave you craving more tomatoes.

We all know and love the Flying Dutchman . The Tomato Wrapped Flying Dutchman kicks this simple and delicious concept up a notch by adding 2 layers of juicy tomatoes to the mix that act as the "buns" of the burger.
Simply ask for a "Flying Dutchman, tomato wrapped". That will unlock the secret for you and your taste buds. It will get written on your receipt as "Flying Dutchman + Tomato Wrap".
The Tomato Wrapped Flying Dutchman will be roughly $0.65 cheaper than the price of the In-N-Out Double Double. Check out all of the In N Out Menu Prices , if you so desire.

The In-N-Out Tomato-Wrapped Flying Dutchman Burger is available at most all locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!
Did you know that this isn't the original In-N-Out Flying Dutchman?
Can't handle the excitement of an Onion Wrapped Flying Dutchman Burger ? Check out the OG In N Out Flying Dutchman .
Or do you prefer your Flying Dutchman in a bowl format? A la Ultimate Animal Style Fries .

Tired of the same old burger routine? Craving a taste adventure that'll make your taste buds do the cha-cha? Well, hold onto your hats, folks, because I've got the inside scoop on a secret menu hack at In-N-Out that's about to rock your world faster than Starbucks' quadruple shot of espresso !

Introducing In N Out's Whole Grilled Onion Wrapped Flying Dutchman – the clandestine creation that's sending shockwaves through social media. Imagine sinking your teeth into a juicy, flavor-packed patty, hugged by two perfectly sliced layers of whole grilled onions that act as the sweet and juicy "bun". So sweet, in fact, that it's practically whispering sweet nothings in your ear. Now, hold that thought and imagine sprinkling it with chopped chilis – whole grilled onions , grilled to caramelized perfection hugging the heck out of some spicy chilis. A little sweet heat never hurt anyone. Are you drooling yet? Because I sure am!

Let's talk about flavor, shall we? These onions aren't just a garnish; they're the co-stars of the show. Each bite is a symphony of savory sweetness, a tantalizing tango of textures that'll have you doing the happy dance in your seat. And don't even get me started on the aroma of grilled onions – it's like a siren song calling you to Flying Dutchman's paradise.

Now, I know what you're thinking – "But is it worth the hype?" My friend, let me tell you, it's worth every single ounce of hype and then some. It's like finding a golden ticket in your burger wrapper, a delicious secret whispered from one burger lover to another.

And hey, if you're feeling extra daring, why not add a splash of secret sauce ? The possibilities are as endless as your imagination. So, gather your squad, hop in the car, and head to In-N-Out for a taste sensation that'll have you coming back for more.

The Whole Grilled Onion Flying Dutchman secret menu hack at In-N-Out is a game-changer. It's bold, it's flavorful, and it's guaranteed to make your taste buds do a happy dance. So, what are you waiting for? Go forth and conquer the In-N-Out Secret Menu – your burger destiny awaits!

I suppose this is kind of a hack on top of a secret menu hack. It's the Flying Dutchman (two slices of cheese melted between two hamburger patties) that is tucked in between two layers of whole grilled onions.
Simply ask for a "Flying Dutchman, whole grilled wrap". That'll unlock the secret for you and your taste buds. It will get written on your receipt as "Flying Dutchman + WhGr Wrap".
This will be roughly $0.65 cheaper than the price of the In-N-Out Double Double. Check out all of the In N Out Menu Prices , if you so desire.

The In-N-Out Onion-Wrapped Flying Dutchman Burger is available at most all locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

As someone who enjoys indulging on a good burger, I think the Flying Dutchman at In-N-Out is the most interesting "meal" on the secret menu. It's two beef patties sandwiched around two slices of cheese. That's it, that is the glorious Flying Dutchman that can be found only at In N Out.

There's no lettuce, no In-N-Out branded wrapper, and definitely no stinkin' bun! Of course you can always ask for those extra toppings, if so desired. Except the bun...that just makes it a burger, my friend.

However, if you want a flying dutchman with a bun, absolutely love onions , then you have got to try the tasty new secret menu variation to the In-N-Out's Flying Dutchman - the Flying Dutchman Burger (whole grilled onion wrapped) !
Our personal favorite additions to the Flying Dutchman are chopped chilis and a whole grilled onion . You can also try making it Animal Style if you like getting a little messy.
No matter how you like your burger, the Flying Dutchman secret menu hack is something worth trying. And it's the only way to build yourself the infamous 100x100 burger.

While the Flying Dutchman is the most common name for this secret menu item, some people refer to it as the “No Bun Burger” or simply “Meat and Cheese.” However, the term “Flying Dutchman” is by far the most recognized and widely used name for this minimalist burger.

What makes the Flying Dutchman unique is its simplicity. It’s the bare essence of a burger, just two slices of American cheese melted between two beef patties. That’s it! No bun, no lettuce, no tomato, no onions, no spread. There’s something liberating about the idea of stripping down a burger to its most basic elements. It’s a reminder that sometimes, less really is more. The Flying Dutchman isn’t trying to be fancy or elaborate; it’s just delivering pure beefy, cheesy goodness. Of course you can add on as many fixings as you want to customize it even further, but this is the OG flying dutchman secret recipe.

There’s something liberating about the idea of stripping down a burger to its most basic elements. It’s a reminder that sometimes, less really is more. The Flying Dutchman isn’t trying to be fancy or elaborate; it’s just delivering pure beefy, cheesy goodness.
Of course you can add on as many fixings as you want to customize it even further, but this is the OG flying dutchman secret recipe.

Prior to 2023, you could simply ask for a "Flying Dutchman". The staff is well-aware of this secret menu hack, but the Grilled Onion-Wrapped Flying Dutchman Burger variation got extremely popular and In-N-Out responded by raising the price. This is mainly due to the the difficulty and extra time required in preparing these alternate variations.

So, you actually want to be more specific to get the original flying dutchman. To do this, ask for a side of two burger patties and two slices of cheese. This is often cheaper and will ensure that you get the true Flying Dutchman.
The current price you get charged when ordering a "Flying Dutchman" in 2024 is typically around $5. This includes adding any additional free toppings to your burger like whole grilled onion wrapped.
If you order just the basic "original" Flying Dutchman (see instructions above), then it might be slightly cheaper ($3 to $4).
The In-N-Out Flying Dutchman is available at most all locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Secret Menu is very expansive and always a great bargain. But are there any completely free upgrades? The answer is yes, there definitely are. You are welcome to ask for extra lettuce, tomato, and onion on any burger. And if you want to get a little more adventurous, feel free to ask for a Mustard Grilled Patty , hot peppers, or even Whole Grilled Onions . And if you want to try a burger that has a little bit of everything, then you have to check out In-N-Out's Animal Style Burger . You can even ask for In-N-Out Special Spread Packets or Hot Pepper Packets on the side. The best part of all is that these things are COMPLETELY FREE to add to your burger!
Free Extra Toppings, Special Spread Packets, & Hot Peppers
Ask for Special Spread Packets or Hot Pepper Packets when you pick up your order. Or if you want them put on your burger for you, ask for extra of any of the normal fixin's when you place your order.
The In-N-Out Free Extras are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Somewhat surprisingly given its simplicity, an In-N-Out Grilled Cheese sandwich is one of In-N-Out Burgers most popular "secret menu" items. This isn't your mother's grilled cheese sandwich though. The secret menu In-N-Out Grilled Cheese is two slices of melted American cheese, hand-leafed lettuce, tomato, spread, with or without onions on a freshly baked bun. This is the vegetarian option at In-N-Out. Sounds like a great snack, right?  If you are going for a full meal, we suggest you compliment your Grilled Cheese with another item off of the In-N-Out secret menu, such as Animal Style Fries .
Two slices of melted American cheese grilled between In-N-Out's buns & loaded with all their fixin's
Ask for a "Grilled Cheese" when ordering. And don't forget to tell them which toppings you want on it.
The In-N-Out Grilled Cheese is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

It's so simple, right?  Upon request, you can order both In-N-Out Large Milk Shakes and In-N-Out Extra Large Milk Shakes off of In-N-Out secret menu . In-N-Out are famous for their delicious milkshakes, but they disappear so quickly. But if you know the secret to ordering a large or extra-large then the goodness can last much longer. There isn't mush else to say, other than that In-N-Out's milk shakes go great with their fries and burgers. So, treat yourself to a large or an extra large shake off of the In-N-Out secret menu. You can even try the secret Neapolitan Shake . Yum!
Large and X-Large sizes for Milkshakes
You want your milkshake, now all you have to do is ask for it in a "large" or "extra-large" cup
The In-N-Out Large Milkshakes are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

Looking for a little extra zing?  One of the more popular items on In-N-Out Burger's secret menu is the In-N-Out Mustard Grilled Patty . By requesting this item, the team over at In-N-Out Burger will slather the patty with mustard before grilling it. The result is a burger with a little more kick. Sounds good, right?  If you want to go even further out of the box, we suggest ordering a " Protein Style Burger " with an In-N-Out Mustard Grilled Patty as the flavor just bursts through the lettuce wrap. Enjoy!
Mustard Spread is applied to the burger patty before it's grilled up
Ask for your burger to be "Mustard Grilled" when ordering.
The In-N-Out Mustard Grilled Patty is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Neapolitan Milkshake is a popular item on In-N-Out Burger secret menu for those who just can't decide on which flavor milkshake they want. The simple In-N-Out Burger menu offers only three choices when it comes to their milkshakes: chocolate, strawberry and vanilla. However, by ordering an In-N-Out Neapolitan Milkshake off of the secret menu, you will receive a milk shake that has been blended with all three flavors! Pretty cool, huh?
A delicious blend of the Chocolate, Strawberry, & Vanilla Milkshakes
Ask for a "Neapolitan Shake" when you place your order, they will know exactly what you want. Or you can ask for a combination of just two of the flavors if you want to mix things up a little.
The In-N-Out Neapolitan Milkshake is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Protein Style Burger is a popular item on the In-N-Out Burger secret menu . In short, by ordering your burger "protein style," you are swapping out the hamburger buns for a crisp lettuce wrap. While this option is obviously appealing to those who are conscious of their carbohydrate intake, we can tell you that the Protein Style Burger is a tasty option for any fan of In-N-Out's legendary burgers. In our experience, the lettuce wraps adds some "freshness" to the burger and is especially good on those days when you want a lighter meal. In-N-Out Burger really has something for everyone!
The hamburger bun is removed, and your burger and all the toppings are wrapped up in their fresh lettuce!
Ask for your burger to made "Protein Style" when you order.
The In-N-Out Protein Style Burger is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Root Beer Float is not your normal Root Beer Float. This one is more like a Root Beer Milkshake. That's because it's actually the Vanilla Shake mixed with Root Beer. Who doesn't love this classic treat during a warm summer day? I know I sure do. This Root Beer Float may be made by the staff. However, we think that the best deal is to buy a Vanilla Milkshake and a Fountain Drink. That way you can split up the Milkshake and the Fountain Drink to make two Root Beer Floats to share!  This should be fine, but you may want to ask the staff to see what is appropriate. It is up to them what you can and can not do.
Root Beer mixed with Vanilla Milkshake
Ask for a "Root Beer Float". Either that, or order both a Vanilla Milkshake and a Root Beer and mix it up yourself!
The In-N-Out Root Beer Float is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

You probably haven't heard of the Ultimate Animal Style Fries from the In-N-Out Secret Menu, but that's okay because you are here now. The same things that make the Animal Style Burger as well as the Animal Style Fries so great are also in the Ultimate Animal Style Fries. That's right, melty cheese, grilled onions, and their secret spread all top this secret menu item.

But what makes the ultimate animal style fries so much better? Adding a chopped up 100% pure beef burger patty to Animal Style Fries turns this side dish into an amazing meal. Some might even go as far as to say it's the ultimate meal. So, for those of you who do consume beef (sorry vegetarians and others) and love animal style fries, this may become your new favorite secret menu item.

What do I do if they won't add the burger patty to my Animal Style Fries? In this case, you have a few options. Option 1 : You can order Animal Style Fries and a single or double burger patty on the side (make sure they know it's a side and not a full burger). This option will set you back around $4.20 to $5 depending on if you get one or two beef patties. Option 2 : You can order an Animal Style Flying Dutchman and a regular order of fries to combine yourself. Note**: You have to ask for a knife and fork to cut up the flying dutchman and add it to your fries. You might as well ask for an extra packet of spread in this case as well. Option 2 will cost you just under $4 - it's a better deal, but it's a little more work, a little messier, and a little less awesome. Finally, Option 3 : This option is if you want to go big. Order Animal Style Fries and an Animal Style Flying Dutchman. Some assembly required. Lots of cheese acquired. You know what to do from here. This will cost you around $6.
How can Animal Style Fries get any better? Try adding chopped chunks of their 100% pure beef burger.

Ask if you can get a hamburger patty to be chopped up and added on top of your Animal Style Fries. If they say no , you're going to have to order a single hamburger patty on the side and make it yourself if you are craving it that badly.
The In-N-Out Ultimate Animal Style Fries are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out Well Done Fries are the perfect option for those who like a little more crunch in their bite. French fries are always a tasty menu item choice…but "Well Done Fries", when ordered off of the In-N-Out Burger "secret menu," are exceptional. While maintaining the fresh, salty taste, In-N-Out Well Done Fries are just a little crispier. appear a little browner and taste a little more like potato chips. They are even better when they are piping hot. We suggest giving them a go and washing them down with a cold milkshake, maybe even an In-N-Out Neapolitan Milkshake . On a side note, you can also get French Fries "Less Done", but they are kinda soggy. But it's really up to how you like them. The In-N-Out Burger secret menu is pretty cool, right?
French Fries cooked a little longer to give them a little extra crunch
Order up some "Well Done French Fries". It's as easy as that.
The In-N-Out Well Done Fries are available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

The In-N-Out secret menu allows more customization of the Onion preparation than one might think. The burgers come normally with a whole slice of raw onion. And most people know that you can get your onions grilled, and they come grilled to perfection and chopped up into little bits. But did you know that you can get a whole slice of grilled onion on your In-N-Out burger? Well you can! In fact, you can even get all three onion options on a single burger if you are crazy enough to try it!
Raw Onions, Diced Grilled Onions, and Whole Grilled Onion Slices

Ask for Grilled Onions or Whole Grilled Onions if you want to try something a little different than the traditional Raw Onion. You can mix and match any combination of these three options on a single burger!
The In-N-Out Grilled Onions (Whole) is available at most locations. Remember to follow the how to order instructions above to ensure that your ordering experience goes as smooth as butter!

paragraphs: Welcome. If you're addicted to cheese, then Jack In the Box will let you order " Additional Cheese Slices " by simply asking for it to be added to your sandwich or hamburger. paragraphs: Topping your burger with a fried egg is all the rage nowadays. And what burger can't be improved by adding an egg? What kind of eggs do they sell? They actually have Four (4) kinds of eggs : round eggs, folded eggs, scrambled eggs, and scrambled egg whites. Check out this infographic to see how each type of egg is made.

How much does it cost to add an egg to a sandwich? Well, prices may vary by location, but they should be around these prices. The round egg will set you back $1.19, while the other three types of eggs cost an additional $1.59.

Feel free to go double egg, but don't try to get around paying an extra quarter or two. We have a good thing going with their All Day Breakfast, so don't screw it up. Add a round egg, folded egg, scrambled egg, or scrambled egg whites to any sandwich or burger that doesn't already have it!

The honey adds a natural sweetness while also being known for its soothing properties.
For those who are feeling sick or just in need of a little comfort, the Medicine Ball is like a warm hug in a cup .

While the drink isn't often displayed on the menu up on the wall behind the counter, the fact that it's on the menu now means that baristas are trained and it's now one of the easiest secret menu items to order at Starbucks. I think we can all be a little grateful for that.

Together, they create a harmonious balance that’s both invigorating and calming. These teas are brewed together and then combined with hot water and steamed lemonade . paragraphs: The fairly new mobile app game, Pokémon GO , took the world by storm when it was released earlier in July of this year. Now, on December 8, 2016, it has taken over Starbucks ! We're here to give you all the details on what this means for Starbucks fans and fans of Pokemon!

First, let's talk about the drink: The Pokémon GO Frappuccino Blended Créme . Now, back to Pokemon GO and what this means for Starbucks and you.
